column6: using HTTP2 with dokploy  Hello, I'm trying to get HTTP2 (and later an HTTP3) services deployed with dokploy. Below is the smallest setup I could make to reproduce my setup.  one Raw docker compose configuration  services:   test:     image: surma/simplehttp2server     expose:       - 5000   create a random domain *.traefik.me without HTTPS terminaison, forwarding to port 5000.   add an extra label in the Raw docker compose based on the newly generated name       labels:       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https The generated docker compose looks like that Preview Compose: services:   test:     image: surma/simplehttp2server     expose:       - 5000     labels:       - traefik.docker.network=dokploy-network       - traefik.http.routers.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.rule=Host(`monitoring-http2test-namyib-c843b3-51-255-22-26.traefik.me`)       - traefik.http.routers.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.entrypoints=web       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadbalancer.server.port=5000       - traefik.http.routers.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.service=monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web       - traefik.enable=true       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https     networks:       - dokploy-network networks:   dokploy-network:     external: true And if I browse to the configured domain, I'm getting an Internal Server Error with the following message in the traefik logs: 2025-11-17T21:49:06Z ERR 500 Internal Server Error error="tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 10.0.1.58 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs"  And it makes sense because surma/simplehttp2server uses self-signed certificate. How to tell traefik to skip certificate verification ?  According to Traefik documentation, ServersTransport is a configuration resource that controls the transport layer settings between Traefik and backend HTTP servers. It supports options like `insecureSkipVerify` to skip TLS verification, and can be attached to a service via Docker labels like: ``` traefik.http.services.Service01.loadBalancer.serversTransport=mytransport ```  So I tried to add an extra label in the Raw docker compose:      labels:       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadBalancer.serversTransport=mytransport Now, traefik says it can't find mytransport 2025-11-17T22:03:07Z ERR error="error building proxy for server URL https://10.0.1.59:5000/: getting RoundTripper: servers transport not found mytransport@docker" entryPointName=web routerName=monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web@docker   I tried to declare mytransport via labels but I'm getting the same previous error      labels:       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadbalancer.server.scheme=https       - traefik.http.services.monitoring-http2test-namyib-12-web.loadBalancer.serversTransport=mytransport       - traefik.http.serversTransports.mytransport.insecureSkipVerify=true Any idea ?
